🎮 Welcome to Build An Animal! ⚡

⚔️ Face off against other players in exciting 1v1 battles!
🎲 Spin for some of the most famous animals in the world!
💪 Combine the best stats from different animals to build the strongest  animal!
🏆 Win battles, earn cash, and climb the ranks!


✨ If you’re loving this AMAZING game, don’t forget to LIKE 👍, FAVORITE ⭐, and SHARE the game with your friends!!
🎉 Join our group for a FREE EPIC CHAIR, and get notified for the latest updates!
